title: euonymus europaeus subsp. tenuifolius
intro: Euonymus europaeus subsp. tenuifolius, commonly known as Spindle, is a subspecies of the Euonymus europaeus plant, which is a type of deciduous shrub or small tree native to Europe. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can aid in wound healing and reducing pain. The therapeutic actions of the Spindle plant include its ability to act as an antipyretic, reducing fever and relieving headaches. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
